candidates.change_summary: Change the airdrop amount from 20 to 10 tokens.
Delete the balance increment so the airdrop never credits tokens.
Invert the overflow-guard require so airDrop always reverts.
Drop the hasNoBalance modifier so users with existing balances can receive additional airdrops.
Delete the post-statement lock release so a second airDrop call reverts due to the permanent lock.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so airDrop reverts unless the caller already has a balance.
Invert the supportsToken comparison so airDrop always reverts.
Change the airdrop amount from +20 to -20 so balances decrease instead of increase.
Delete the balance increment so the airdrop no longer changes tokenBalance.
Delete the reentry-lock reset so _locked stays true and any subsequent airDrop call reverts.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so only senders with a nonzero balance can call airDrop.
Invert the supportsToken equality check so legitimate Bank callers are rejected and others accepted.
Delete the statement that adds 20 tokens to the caller's balance, so airDrop no longer changes tokenBalance.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier so callers with a nonzero balance can also receive the airdrop, changing resulting balances.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so only callers with a nonzero balance pass, causing zero-balance callers to revert and keep balance 0.
Invert the supportsToken check so legitimate callers revert, leaving tokenBalance unchanged for them.
Invert the lock check so the first airDrop call reverts, leaving tokenBalance untouched.
Increase the airdrop amount from 20 to 30, so balances after airDrop() differ from the original.
Remove the hasNoBalance requirement so accounts with a nonzero balance can receive additional airdrops.
Change the string checked in supportsToken so the require fails and airDrop always reverts.
